handmade: carved Haussmann facade (mansard + dormers, dentil cornice, pedimented windows, balconies with baluster cuts, lit arched shopfronts), built from seeded tapered gouge strokes in key / tint / dark-tint / shade blocks
gouged roadway and pavement, kerb, long horizontal cast-shadow strokes
rear platform: arched lit opening, canopy, floor, step and hangers, ring chain, black stanchion, bell cord and tassel
carved destination board MADELEINE - BASTILLE (serif capitals with seeded gouge-bitten edges, cut out of an ink board)

articulated silhouette puppets: long-necked man (felt hat with cut braid notches, cord end), bowler-hatted jostler, two seeded runners (coat/cap, skirt/cloche); Catmull-Rom part outlines, FK with pins and angle limits, replacement hands (fist / flat / open)
rear bay pane re-cut as a plain tint block so the A6 seat can be read
